summary: Linear search for an ID. Given a search value a1 and an array base a2, scans an array of 12-byte records whose ID field sits at +4, for the first record whose ID equals a1. The element count is dword_5E7894 (the array span is a2 + 12 * dword_5E7894). Returns the address of the matching record, or 0 when no record matches or the scan leaves the array span. Matches the legacy ABI label Array_of_Struct_Linear_Search_by_ID.

local_names.a1: search value compared against each record's ID field
local_names.a2: base address of the record array
local_names.result: scan cursor over the array; holds the matching record address on success
local_names.dword_5E7894: global holding the number of records in the array

operations.description: result = a2: start the scan at the array base.
Short-circuit the loop when the first record already matches: *(a2+4) == a1.
Linear scan: advance result by the 12-byte record stride while result stays below the array span a2 + 12 * dword_5E7894 and the ID field at result+4 does not equal a1.
Failure path: return 0 when the scan left the array span (result >= a2 + 12 * dword_5E7894) or the ID field at result+4 still does not equal a1.
Return the address of the matching record (result).
Legacy ABI label Array_of_Struct_Linear_Search_by_ID corroborates the scan shape: an array of 12-byte records, ID compared at +4, element count held in dword_5E7894.
